import Base

# Empty input supplies a dead cell and remains empty.
def uncons_zero(
  cells: List<&2, U32>,
  next: U32 -> List<&2, U32> -> List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      next(0, Nil{})
    case Con{center, rest}:
      next(center, rest)

# One boundary predicate controls both the east neighbor and row rollover.
def horizontal(
  cells: List<&2, U32>, +width: U32, +column: U32, left: U32
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{+center, +rest}:
      +next = (column + 1 : U32)
      +inside = U32.is_lt(next, width)
      uncons_zero(rest, right => unused =>
        (Bool.pick(U32, U32.is_zero(column), 0, left) + center +
          Bool.pick(U32, inside, right, 0) : U32) <>
        horizontal(rest, width, Bool.pick(U32, inside, next, 0), center))

# Removing the center gives eight neighbors; its bit joins counts 2 and 3.
def life(+center: U32, sum: U32) -> U32:
  Bool.to_u32(U32.is_eq(U32.or((sum - center : U32), center), 3))

# The finite center spine bounds three streams with implicit dead suffixes.
def vertical(
  cells: List<&2, U32>, north: List<&2, U32>,
  middle: List<&2, U32>, south: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{center, rest}:
      uncons_zero(north, n => ns =>
        uncons_zero(middle, m => ms =>
          uncons_zero(south, s => ss =>
            life(center, (n + m + s : U32)) <>
              vertical(rest, ns, ms, ss))))

# Valid input length supplies the height, including either empty dimension.
def step(+width: U32, height: U32, +cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +stride = U32.to_nat(width)
  +bands = horizontal(cells, width, 0, 0)
  north = List.append(&2, U32, List.replicate(U32, stride, 0), bands)
  south = List.drop(&2, U32, bands, stride)
  vertical(cells, north, bands, south)

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+remaining:
      evolve(remaining, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
hypothesis: Preserve the stimulus-inspired separation of occupancy, neighborhood and boundary. Two concrete compressions improve the existing mechanism: one horizontal boundary predicate now controls both east-neighbor admission and column rollover, eliminating modulo; B3/S23 becomes (neighbors OR center)=3. For a dead center this requires exactly three neighbors; for a live center it accepts exactly two or three. The separable stencil, zero-extended streams and structurally bounded traversal remain unchanged.
findings: The repaired prior submission passed all reported behavioral probes and composition checks; semantic review found no issues. The earlier computed-scrutinee compiler finding was confirmed and repaired through continuations, which this revision retains. Style failure remains unresolved: every declaration missed the strict level-5 target, despite improved readings of vertical composition. This revision shares the boundary decision and collapses birth/survival into one bitwise predicate. Its compiler, runtime and style results remain unverified.
